# Remit-Scout

> Remit-Scout is an independent comparison platform for international money transfers. We aggregate live quotes from 25+ licensed providers (Wise, Remitly, Western Union, etc.) and rank them by total cost, speed, and trust score across 200+ corridors worldwide.

## Key Pages

- [Compare Money Transfers](https://remitscout.com/send-money): Side-by-side comparison of providers for any corridor
- [All Corridors](https://remitscout.com/corridors): Browse all supported remittance corridors
- [Exchange Rates](https://remitscout.com/exchange-rates): Live mid-market exchange rates
- [Provider Directory](https://remitscout.com/learn/providers): Reviews and scores for every provider
- [Methodology](https://remitscout.com/methodology): How we calculate Remit-Score and rank providers
